releaseConditions: Snapshot, build, repair, verification and publishing contracts are declared frozen.
A separate integration approval is granted for the desktop branch.

blockedIntegrations.allowedBeforeRelease: Provider interfaces, deterministic fixtures and local-only workspace behavior.

Local preview and deterministic browser/diagnostic fixtures.

Redacted fixture contracts and presentation only.

prohibitedDesktopBranchActions: Edit Builder V2 implementation or qualification evidence.
Call a live Builder V2 mutation path.
Create a database migration or production route.
Change dispatch, settlement, rollout or customer-default flags.
Publish from an unverified workspace filesystem.
